stock.description: Biosino Bio-Technology & Science, Inc. engages in the manufacture, sale, and distribution of in-vitro diagnostic reagents and pharmaceutical products. It distributes a variety of mono and double diagnostic reagent products which are used by various medical institutions, independent laboratories, government public health testing centers, and individuals. The company was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
